brief:
Pro-Palestine university groups marched through London on October 7 to mark the anniversary of the date, proceeding despite police requests to postpone the demonstration, Al Jazeera English reported. The students took to the streets in defiance of law enforcement guidance ahead of the march.

The demonstration reflected ongoing activism among British university groups regarding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, particularly around the symbolic date marking the start of the latest cycle of violence.
dek: Pro-Palestine students took to the streets of London on October 7, despite police calls to postpone the march.
title: Pro-Palestine students march in London despite police objections
